title: Week 6 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “federalism”?
options: A constitutional process in which the House charges and the Senate tries specified misconduct.
A structured set of beliefs about government, society, rights, economy, and public priorities.
The unemployed actively seeking work as a percentage of the labor force.
A constitutional system dividing authority between national and state governments.
questions.explanation: Federalism means a constitutional system dividing authority between national and state governments.
choices: A constitutional process in which the House charges and the Senate tries specified misconduct.
A structured set of beliefs about government, society, rights, economy, and public priorities.
The unemployed actively seeking work as a percentage of the labor force.
A constitutional system dividing authority between national and state governments.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “reserved powers”?
options: A judicial authorization to search a specified place or person for described evidence.
A legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.
Powers retained by states or the people under the Tenth Amendment.
An organization seeking to influence government by electing candidates and coordinating public policy.
questions.explanation: Reserved powers means powers retained by states or the people under the Tenth Amendment.
choices: A judicial authorization to search a specified place or person for described evidence.
A legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.
Powers retained by states or the people under the Tenth Amendment.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “concurrent powers”?
options: A central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.
Powers exercised by both national and state governments.
A market dominated by a small number of interdependent firms.
The First Amendment prohibition on government establishment of religion.
questions.explanation: Concurrent powers means powers exercised by both national and state governments.
choices: A central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.
Powers exercised by both national and state governments.
A market dominated by a small number of interdependent firms.
The First Amendment prohibition on government establishment of religion.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “preemption”?
options: A cost or benefit imposed on a third party and not fully reflected in a transaction price.
A person who benefits from a good or action without contributing to its cost.
Displacement of state or local law by valid federal law.
A Senate practice of extended debate or procedural delay that may require cloture to end.
questions.explanation: Preemption means displacement of state or local law by valid federal law.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “intergovernmental relations”?
options: Cooperation, bargaining, conflict, and fiscal relationships among levels of government.
The interest rate on overnight reserve lending that the Federal Reserve targets within a range.
An organized collection demonstrating research, reasoning, participation, revision, and reflection.
A measure of average price change for a defined basket of consumer goods and services.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “home rule”?
options: Public programs pooling risks such as unemployment, disability, health cost, or old-age income.
A judicial opinion disagreeing with the majority’s result or reasoning.
Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.
Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
questions.explanation: Home rule means authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.
choices: Public programs pooling risks such as unemployment, disability, health cost, or old-age income.
A judicial opinion disagreeing with the majority’s result or reasoning.
Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 6 inquiry?
options: A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student assigns a policy function to the correct level only after checking constitutional and statutory authority.
